changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwtax AS SELECT t.id, t.facility_id, t.code, t.name, t.tax_type, t.percentage, t.fixed_amount, t.currency, t.calculation_type, t.applicable_on, t.valid_from, t.valid_to, t.is_default, t.active, t.description, t.created_by, t.created_date, t.last_modified_by, t.last_modified_date, t.citizen_category, t.apply_on_patient_copayment, t.apply_on_claim_share FROM public.tax t;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwtax TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwtax FROM report_user;
